text:
sam: Heads up — keystore shard 7 is scheduled for decommission in eu-central at 09:00UTC and the warmpool bootstrapers hit a bunch of decrypt errors in staging last night.
maria: Ugh. Did staging use the new shard mapping?
sam: yeah, tls logs show `decrypt: sharded-keystore: shard 7 not found` from warmpool-init on several nodes.
jin: That explains the warmup drops we saw (metric: gpu.warmpool.ready <-> target). We saw 40% fewer nodes ready for 10m.
lisa: Any audit log noise? we need to keep the paper trail for security review.
sam: audit events are there but missing the shard id in some entries — looks like client lib fell back to empty shard header. snippet: ```2026-03-22T23:12:01Z WARN keystore: missing-shard-id path=/var/run/keystore sock=/run/ks.sock```
oncall-bot: Incident: warmpool delta 35% (eu-central) — automated alert created #inc-1223
maria: For prod cutover we should do a phased removal: (1) add server-side redirect for shard7 -> shard3, (2) add allowlist on eu-keystore-proxy, (3) start decommission.
jin: Redirect sounds lowest-risk. Can we do a quick proxy rule that returns `301 shard->3` for the shard header?
sam: proxy supports header rewrite. sample config: `x-keystore-shard: 7 -> 3` in envoy route. I'll push a canary to staging.
lisa: Also need IAM check: nodes assume role `gpu-warmup` which has kms:Decrypt on `arn:aws:kms:eu-central:***:key/keystore-shard-*`. If we retire shard7 keys we must ensure role still maps to shard3 key alias.
maria: Right — ops checklist item: update role binding, update key alias, add audit entry for rotation. I'll DRY document it.
devops-bot: Deploy started by sam: `deploy keystore-proxy-canary (revision=b3f2)`
sam: Canary deployed to staging, logs show rewrite working, decrypt errors gone in staging within 60s.
jin: Nice. What's the cost impact if we keep shard7 redirect for 30 days as fallback?
maria: Slight increase in keystore qps and cross-AZ egress for a week — estimate ~0.6% on keystore bill, but saves churn and risk.
lisa: Security review: can we capture extra audit fields for the redirect period? Need shard_origin and proxy_node tags in logs.
sam: yes I'll append `shard_origin=shard7` and `proxy_node` to audit payloads. simple change in proxy: `audit.extra_fields += {"shard_origin": request.header.shard}`
maria: After a week, if no hits to shard7, schedule actual key rotation and remove redirect.
jin: Let's gate prod decommission on these checks: 
- canary success (staging) ✅
- audit enrichment in prod ✅
- IAM alias corrected ✅
- cost approval from finance for temporary egress (says @finance if needed)
sam: I'll open a tiny PR for the proxy plus a terraform change for the key alias. PR link: https://git.company/repo/pulls/1234
lisa: Add me as reviewer for audit changes.
devops-bot: Alert resolved: warmpool delta returned to baseline.
maria: OK, plan sounds good. I'll draft a one-pager for security and ops and tag ownership.
sam: tagging owners: @maria (rollback lead), @jin (warmpool), @lisa (security/audit). I'll schedule prod window 09:15UTC after small sync. :thumbsup:
